expectations.text: Output includes a steelman/positive framing of the free-tier removal plan before critiquing it
expectations.evidence: Opens with 'Tóm lại là: free tier đang tốn 80% công sức support mà tỷ lệ chuyển thành trả phí quá thấp... đây là vấn đề unit economics thực sự đáng xử lý, không phải chuyện nhỏ' — recaps the plan at its strongest before any pushback.

expectations.text: Output identifies at least one unverified assumption specific to this plan, not generic advice
expectations.evidence: Names three specific assumptions: '80% traffic support' conflated with 'free user tệ' vs missing self-service; conversion measured only short-term; sudden 0đ→299k barrier.

expectations.text: Output offers at least one concrete alternative approach, not just 'consider other options'
expectations.evidence: 'tách kênh hỗ trợ (free chỉ có community/FAQ/chatbot...) và siết lại phạm vi tính năng của free tier' / 'đổi free vĩnh viễn thành free trial có thời hạn (ví dụ 14 ngày)'.

expectations.text: Output describes a concrete consequence/risk if the identified weakness turns out true
expectations.evidence: Paragraph starting 'Rủi ro nếu giả định sai:' spells out lead-loss and support-cost-not-actually-dropping scenarios.

expectations.text: Output ends with an open question or suggested next step for the user to verify
expectations.evidence: Closes with two verification questions plus a suggested 4-6 week pilot before full rollout.

expectations.text: Output does not simply agree with the plan without pushback
expectations.evidence: Substantial pushback throughout; never just endorses the plan.
